title: Repository stale draft PR hygiene review
objective: Classify old open draft pull requests against fresh main so repository hygiene can improve without accidentally discarding still-unique functionality.

verified_open_drafts.title: Archive DATA PING Platform architecture and transition guard
Recover Data Terminal full raw row preservation implementation
Register framework execution harness and readiness gate

required_work: Fetch each PR head/base, changed paths, commit list and current mergeability against fresh main.
For every changed behavior, determine whether equivalent or newer functionality is already on main, citing exact replacement paths, PRs or commits.
Separate documentation/archive-only value from executable behavior.
Identify any unique code or contract that would be lost if the PR were closed.
For SAFE_TO_CLOSE, provide explicit supersession evidence and confirm no branch deletion is required.
For REBASE_OR_EXTRACT_SMALL_REMAINDER, specify the minimal unique remainder and bounded target paths.
guardrails: Do not close, merge, retarget or modify any PR during analysis.
Age is not evidence of supersession.
No SAFE_TO_CLOSE verdict without exact current-main replacement evidence or proof the change is obsolete by contract.
Do not alter market, portfolio, research or canonical semantics.
codex_handoff_condition: A PR contains a small unique remainder that should be extracted into a fresh bounded branch rather than resurrecting the full stale PR.
owner_action_condition: A PR is classified SAFE_TO_CLOSE with high-confidence supersession evidence. Closure remains an explicit repository-maintenance action, not an automatic analysis side effect.
clean_noop_condition: All five drafts remain potentially unique or evidence is insufficient to classify them safely.
